core_claims.name: forallElim / forallProduct / forallProductRound / sumForall / forallTri / triRound
core_claims.scope: Dependent universal elimination; product and three-element correspondences as Iff with pointwise recovery; a global universal branch gives a pointwise sum, without claiming the converse.

core_claims.name: existsElim / existsCurry / existsCurryRound / existsSum / existsProduct / existsTri
core_claims.scope: Dependent-pair elimination and curried equivalence; full data Iso for existential-over-sum and existential over Tri; only the justified implication from a shared product witness to separate witnesses.

core_claims.name: evenWitness / oddWitness / witnessEven / witnessOdd / evenWitnessLeft / oddWitnessLeft / witnessEvenLeft / witnessOddLeft
core_claims.scope: Construct and consume arbitrary even/odd witnesses as multiples of two and successor multiples, with two on either multiplication side.

core_claims.name: leWitness / witnessLE / leExists
core_claims.scope: For all m,n, LE m n iff there is a natural difference k with add k m = n; the forward direction constructs k.

core_claims.name: notExists / existsNot
core_claims.scope: A refuted dependent existential iff a refutation for every witness; an existential counterexample refutes a dependent universal. No counterexample-extraction converse is asserted.

core_claims.name: canonicalPairEqual / canonicalIso
core_claims.scope: Full Iso between all Nat and the dependent pair of raw Bin with Canonical proof. The binary-side inverse proves equality of the entire dependent pair using canonical proof uniqueness.

deviations: Uses Idris DPair witness syntax instead of Agda Sigma/exists mixfix syntax.

Universal product/finite-domain, dependent currying, and negated-existential correspondences do not assert extensional equalities of function values. They retain two conversion directions and the stated pointwise laws without an axiom.

verification.compiler: Idris2 0.8.0 via the pinned Nix environment
verification.totality: %default total; no proof holes, postulates, unsafe casts or termination overrides
verification.independent_acceptance: Recorded separately by the primary editor and independent reviewer
